risk_note: RV2 money (commission versions). BR-CALC-15 / BR-CALC-27 细则「仅补贴变化的版本」(D10-1258): orders bumps commission_version when the effective N is unchanged but the subsidy commission differs from the subsidy recorded on the CURRENT version's totals row (NULL → the order's commission_splits snapshot subsidy); null ≡ 0; an absent subsidy field keeps the stored value; a payload whose platform modified time is earlier than the order's is not bumped for the subsidy (equal time → bumped); re-delivery writes nothing; N and subsidy moving together bump once (existing N path, B1-18f current subsidy). The bump rides the existing row_version CAS UPDATE (conflict → re-read and re-plan; D10-1267: this is the optimistic lock of 08's 'WHERE commission_version', SQL shape not pinned). Commission estimates port (ledger patch #3202) gains recordedSubsidy (read) and refreshSubsidy (write): the new version copies the previous version's amount rows and base_fen per (user_id, role) — preserving an R7-repriced version — and recomputes only n_total = stored N + new subsidy, pre_base_deduct, platform_est_profit, writing the subsidy column; both through insertVersion (query builder) in the sync transaction. rebate: a subsidy-only version only calls refreshSubsidy (ESTIMATED / WAITING / CREDITED): no COMMISSION_CHANGED, rebate_status unchanged, no ledger entry, notification, adjust candidate or clawback. Terminal VOID / CLAWED_BACK keep the existing locked_noop for both N and subsidy paths (D10-1268, FU-TERMINAL-VERSION-ROWS). Money r1 S1 fix: planOrderSyncColumns writes platform_modified_at as max(stored, payload) so an older payload no longer rewinds the stale-check basis (changes main's column semantics: an older payload no longer overwrites this column; no frozen case pins the old overwrite; with mtimeOrdering on, older payloads were already dropped). New ports/new methods are optional on RebateDependencies.estimates (frozen kits hand-write { bases, refresh }); subsidy is not in OrderSyncColumns' keys ([AC-B1-08i#14]). specs/attribution.md: taobao 未核实 note adds the deprecated share_relative_rate "0.10" example (pointer to rebate-private docs-mirror only, D10-1266). Host: tsc -b test apps/api 0; eslint / prettier 0; orders int 222 files 1910 green (incl. subsidy-version 11); commission + settlement int 134 files 901; test/spec unit 29709; apps/api unit 5128.

reviews.note: Codex money review (effort medium). r1 fail 1×S1: production has no mtimeOrdering, an older payload rewound platform_modified_at so an interleaved re-delivery of an older subsidy payload was judged newer and wrote a subsidy version; fixed in 30022030d (platform_modified_at monotonic, unit regressions A→B→re-deliver A). r2 pass, no new findings; terminal branch has no special case (D10-1268).

spec_test_review.note: Rule tests by fresh independent Claude. Attempt 1 (subsidy-version.int, 6 red). r1 fail 4×S1 (basis = current version's recorded subsidy incl. NULL fallback; R7-repriced shares kept per beneficiary; subsidy-branch conflict re-read; same-transaction rollback) → attempt 2 version-basis.int (11 red). r2 fail 1×S1 (pin WHERE commission_version SQL) → D10-1267 not adopted (row_version CAS). Gate record (not counted) raised VOID / CLAWED_BACK coverage → D10-1268 out_of_scope, FU-TERMINAL-VERSION-ROWS (existing N-path behaviour). Gate record 2 pass. The implementation showed two version-basis cases red at the v1 precondition (owner share row role written 'self', actual 'share') — red-check had accepted them red at the wrong assertion; D10-1269 attempt 3 changed only those 6 role literals; red/3 then red after the subsidy sync (:329, :408). Gate record 3 (not counted) pass.
